stages.sub: Explain what drives a current account deficit or surplus, and why governments might turn to protectionism.

steps.q: Country A's unit labour costs are much higher than its rivals', so its goods cost more abroad than similar foreign goods. What happens to its exports compared with its imports?
steps.hint: If your goods cost more than rivals', would foreigners buy more or less of them?
